notes.title: Simon the Sorcerer Origins adventure game announced for release in October
notes.notes: Simon the Sorcerer Origins has been announced for release in October, a prequel to the 1993 classic and it sounds fantastic.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/simon-the-sorcerer-origins-adventure-game-announced-for-release-in-october/
